newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans slide as Refco sells, stops hit.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans slide as Refco sells, stops hit.

text.p: Losses were extended in CBOT soybean futures at midday and the May contract was in fast dealings as Refco Inc sold at least seven million bushels and stops were hit, traders said.
"Refco started selling beans this morning and they're still selling now," a trader said. "It looks like they're getting out of some (positions)."
Trade sources said the fund selling spooked the market which has gained more than $1 per bushel in the last month supported primarily by fund buying.
Traders said the market had been braced for a sell-off and were concerned a major commodity fund like Refco would lead the surge back below $8.00 per bushel.
At 1146 CST, soybeans were down 10-1/4 to 2-1/2 with May off 8-1/2 at $8.47.
